title: The Post-Training Dilemma: Why We Should Rethink the Sequential SFT-RL Paradigm
abstract: arXiv:2601.07389v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This position paper argues that the sequential supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning (SFT-then-RL) pipeline---the de facto paradigm for large language model (LLM) post-training---has a fundamental property that cannot be fixed by hyperparameter tuning: SFT and RL optimize over nearly orthogonal parameter subspaces, so RL inevitably degrades the capabilities acquired during the preceding SFT phase. Under the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition, which is empirically observed for over-parameterized networks, we show that RL increases the SFT loss by at least $\frac{\mu}{2}\mathrm{dist}(\theta_{\mathrm{RL}}, \Theta^*_{\mathrm{SFT}})^2$ for some $\mu>0$. Although the KL penalty can constrain distributional shift, it cannot correct the underlying gradient misalignment between the two objectives. Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B across four tasks confirm the theoretical predictions: on MATH-500, Alpaca, HH-RLHF, and SST-2,

translated_title: 后训练困境：为什么我们应该重新思考顺序式SFT-RL范式
translated_abstract: 这篇立场论文认为，先监督微调后强化学习（SFT-then-RL）的顺序流程——作为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的事实标准范式——存在一个无法通过超参数调整来修复的根本性缺陷：SFT和RL在几乎正交的参数子空间上进行优化，因此RL不可避免地会损害前一阶段SFT所获得的能力。在Polyak-Łojasiewicz（PL）条件下（该条件在过参数化网络中被经验性观察到），我们证明RL至少会使SFT损失增加 $\frac{\mu}{2}\mathrm{dist}(\theta_{\mathrm{RL}}, \Theta^*_{\mathrm{SFT}})^2$（其中 $\mu>0$）。尽管KL惩罚可以约束分布偏移，但它无法纠正两个目标之间潜在的梯度不对齐问题。在Qwen3-0.6B上跨四个任务的实验证实了理论预测：在MATH-500、Alpaca、HH-RLHF和SST-2上（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文从理论上证明SFT与RL在近乎正交的参数子空间上进行优化，导致RL阶段不可避免地损害SFT所获得的能力，且KL惩罚无法修复这一梯度不对齐问题，因此主张重新思考顺序式SFT-RL后训练范式。
